Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with searchable CC player rankings and prediction, nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: SAM cast and queue fixes, nearer targets for Ogi/Tendo starters, and an optional one-time late-facing test (off by default; needs game automatic facing). Clearer Ping Helper failure reasons and more buffer tests. Longer enemy arrows plus blue ally-to-enemy target arrows. Smart Action protection separated from execution. Medicine-kit preview and clearer detection details; real kit detection is not yet confirmed fixed. Live movement and facing testing still required.
